english: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck and attach up to 2 Basic {{e|雷}} Energy cards you find there to your Benched {{e|雷}} Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
chinese: 查看自己牌库上方5张卡牌，选择其中最多2张「基本{{e|雷}}能量」，以任意方式附着于备战区的{{e|雷}}宝可梦身上。将剩余的卡牌放回牌库并重洗牌库。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则选择对手场上宝可梦身上附着的1个能量，放于弃牌区。

english: Put 1 of your Basic Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.
chinese: 选择自己场上的1只'''基础'''宝可梦，将该宝可梦，以及放于其身上的所有卡牌，放回手牌。

english: Discard a Special Energy from each of your opponent's Pokémon.
chinese: 选择对手所有宝可梦身上附着的{{TCG|特殊能量卡|特殊能量}}各1个，放于弃牌区。

english:
You can use this card only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn.

Attach a Basic {{e|火}} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon. If you do, draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.
chinese:
这张卡牌，只有在上一个对手的回合，自己的宝可梦'''{{TCG|昏厥}}'''时才可使用。

选择自己弃牌区中的1张「基本{{e|火}}能量」，附着于自己的宝可梦身上。然后，从牌库上方抽取卡牌，直到自己的手牌变为6张为止。

english: Choose up to 2 of your Ancient Pokémon and attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to each of them. If you attached any Energy in this way, draw 3 cards.
chinese: 选择自己最多2只「{{TCG|古代}}」宝可梦，各附着1张弃牌区中的基本能量。然后，从自己牌库上方抽取3张卡牌。

english: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. During this turn, your Pokémon can't attack. ''(This includes Pokémon that come into play this turn.)''
chinese:
在使用这张卡牌的回合结束前，自己所有的宝可梦，无法使用招式。（也包括新出场的宝可梦。）

选择自己牌库中最多2张基本能量，附着于自己的1只宝可梦身上。并重洗牌库。

english: Choose up to 2 of your {{e|Darkness}} Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a Basic {{e|Darkness}} Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. If you attached Energy to your Active Pokémon in this way, it is now Poisoned.
chinese: 选择自己最多2只{{e|恶}}宝可梦，各附着1张自己牌库中的「基本{{e|恶}}能量」。并重洗牌库。附着于战斗宝可梦身上的情况下，令那只宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|中毒}}'''状态。

english: Move a basic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.
chinese: 选择自己场上宝可梦身上附着的1个基本能量，转附于自己其他宝可梦身上。
